title: Commitments survive restarts with no duplicate experiments or cross-project leakage
user_story: As the owner I want long work across many turns and restarts to keep every requirement, never repeat an experiment and never mix projects (agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md B4; RQ-07).

requirements.description: continuity.snapshot/compare report lost or changed missions and protocols, a lost approval, an approval that ran twice, a lost run, a broken or rewritten ledger, and snapshots of different topics.
continuity.leakage reports this topic's missions, protocols or runs visible in another project, without switching the active project.

nonfunctional: Twenty snapshot comparisons in under 10 s
outputs: list of continuity issues (empty when continuity held)
preconditions: A topic in a disposable project

scenarios.expected: Three real process restarts: the running mission becomes interrupted, no issue, one run
A lost mission, a changed protocol and a second run per approval are reported
A rewritten or broken ledger is reported
A used approval cannot run a second experiment
Another project does not see the topic; the active project is unchanged
Snapshots of different topics are refused

recovery: Fix at continuity or the recovery it observes; never weaken a check to pass. TASK-CONTINUITY-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR and a second project; real restarts in a new Python process (tests/_env.py); evidence in docs/qa/evidence/continuity-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 7 tests on e4a6b0f, all failing (no continuity module). GREEN: 7/7.
